subject: Observability renewal & retention decisions (Datadog / Grafana / Sentry)
messages:
From: Lena Schmidt <lena@datadog.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@vendor-ops.example.com
Date: Thu, 02 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Datadog renewal proposal (Q3 start)

Hi Hannah / Marissa,

Thanks again for the time last week. Attached is the Q3 renewal proposal for Redwood Inference (Datadog account RDW-019). Highlights: 15% renewal credit vs. list for a 12-month term, option to add log retention addon at a reduced rate for the west-coast cluster, and a proposed SLA exception for the long-tail ingestion burst we discussed.

Attachments: Datadog_Q3_renewal_proposal.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

Key asks from our side: confirmation of the start date (targeting 2026-07-01) and whether you want the retention addon scoped to logs ingested by dedicated capacity clusters.

Happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Lena Schmidt
Enterprise Sales
Datadog

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Lena Schmidt <lena@datadog.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, procurement@vendor-ops.example.com
Date: Mon, 06 Apr 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Datadog renewal proposal (Q3 start)

Lena — thanks for the proposal. A few quick internal notes/asks before we escalate to procurement: 

- Can you split the retention addon pricing by region (us-west vs us-east)? Our cost model treats those differently.
- The SLA exception language looks fine in principle but legal needs a short justification we can attach to the PO. Can you provide a 1-paragraph technical rationale?
- Marissa / Connor: we should decide whether to consolidate logs into Grafana Cloud for lower-cost archival. If we go that route, Datadog retention addon should only cover hot/nearline logs.

Connor — can you run a 90-day cost projection (current usage + expected growth) and drop into the Jira ticket? Marissa — can you take the lead on contract language once procurement has the numbers?

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, procurement@vendor-ops.example.com
Date: Tue, 07 Apr 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Datadog renewal proposal (Q3 start)

Hannah / team — attaching a quick snapshot I pulled this morning. Summary: 

- Average log ingestion (prod) = 12 TB/day over last 30 days; spikes to 20 TB/day during incident windows.
- Current retention: 30 days on Datadog; cold archives stored in our S3 buckets (Grafana Cloud OK for cheap archival).
- If we keep hot retention on Datadog at 60 days, estimated incremental cost (monthly) = ~$48k; Grafana archival at projected rates = ~$6k/month.

I uploaded the full numbers to the Jira ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-4123 (see attachments section). My recommendation: keep 30 days as-is for Datadog, buy retention addon only for west-coast cluster (where latency-sensitive debugging happens), and offload long-term archival to Grafana/S3. That minimizes unit cost while preserving debugability.

Connor
Senior Cloud Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Grafana_retention_addon_quote.xlsx (spreadsheet, 2 sheets)

From: Sophie Tran <sophie@sentry.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, procurement@vendor-ops.example.com
Date: Wed, 08 Apr 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Sentry usage and seat renewal timeline

Hi Hannah / team — looping in Sentry briefly since we surface a lot of tracing/errors there during post-incident analysis. Our upcoming renewal window for Sentry (account RW-ENG-05) is aligned with your Datadog window. If you're consolidating archival to Grafana/S3, that won't impact Sentry directly, but note that extended retention for traces/attachments is billed separately.

If you want, I can send a one-page summary of what trace retention tiers look like and an estimate for 90 days vs 180 days.

Best,
Sophie Tran
Account Manager, Sentry

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: procurement@vendor-ops.example.com, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Schmidt <lena@datadog.com>, Carlos Ruiz <carlos@grafanacloud.io>, Sophie Tran <sophie@sentry.io>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 15:44:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Observability renewal & retention decisions (Datadog / Grafana / Sentry)

Team — decision summary and next steps for procurement: 

1) Datadog: accept 12-month term with the 15% renewal credit but limit the Datadog retention addon to us-west cluster only. Request: Lena, please provide the 1-paragraph SLA-exception justification so we can attach to the PO.

2) Grafana Cloud: proceed with archival plan — procurement to accept the Grafana retention addon quote for cold storage (monthly billing). Carlos, please confirm the estimated egress costs to our S3 archival target.

3) Sentry: keep current tier; Sophie to send a one-pager on trace retention options. No action required now.

Procurement — please open the PO under deal id PO-2026-OBS-0034 and route DocuSign envelope once legal confirms the SLA exception wording. Links: DocuSign envelope https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABCD1234efgh ; Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-4123

Attachments to include on PO: Datadog_Q3_renewal_proposal.pdf, Grafana_retention_addon_quote.xlsx, SLA-exception-request.docx

Thanks all — aim to have DocuSign routed by EOD Wednesday (2026-04-14).

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
